import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load datasets
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_json("input/train.json")
test = pd.read_json("input/test.json")

# Define numerical features available in both sets
num_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
]

# Prepare text features
print("Preparing text features...")
for df in [train, test]:
    df["request_title"] = df["request_title"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df["request_text_edit_aware"] = df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df["text_combined"] = df["request_title"] + " " + df["request_text_edit_aware"]

# Numerical features
print("Extracting numerical features...")
X_train_num = train[num_features].fillna(0).values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_num = test[num_features].fillna(0).values.astype(np.float32)

# Text features via TF-IDF
print("Computing TF-IDF...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=800, sublinear_tf=True, stop_words="english")
X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(train["text_combined"]).toarray()
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(test["text_combined"]).toarray()

# Combine features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_tfidf, X_train_num])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_tfidf, X_test_num])
y_train = train["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(int)

# Hold-out split for validation
print("Performing train/validation split...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train LightGBM
print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "n_estimators": 400,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
print("Evaluating on hold-out validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission
print("Generating submission...")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

sub_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
